title: SS Retail IPO Details
intro:
SS Retail IPO is a book build issue of ₹500.00 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 85.08 lakh shares aggregating to ₹360.00 crores and offer for sale of 33.02 lakh shares aggregating to ₹140.00 crores.

SS Retail IPO opens for subscription on Sep 16, 2026 and closes on Sep 18, 2026. The allotment for the SS Retail IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 21, 2026. SS Retail IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 23, 2026.

SS Retail IPO is set issue price band at ₹403 to ₹424 per share. The lot size for an application is 35 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,840 (35 shares) (based on upper price).

Anand Rathi Advisors Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to SS Retail IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated June 2016, SS Retail Ltd. is a multi-brand retail chain for mobile phones, accessories and other electronic items, with operations across Maharashtra, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Goa and Gujarat. It primarily focuses on Tier II and Tier III and beyond cities and, as of March 31, 2026, operated 503 stores across 215 cities, covering approximately 2,41,365 sq. ft.

The Company operates under its proprietary brands ‘SS Mobile’, ‘Mobile Exchange Wala’ and ‘The Mobile Space’ through a combination of company-owned and franchisee-operated store formats. Its product portfolio includes mobile phones, pre-owned smartphones, accessories, televisions, laptops and tablets, along with ancillary services such as mobile protection plans, EMI facilities, anti-theft software and mobile recharge services. As of July 31, 2026, its retail network had expanded to 536 stores covering approximately 2,60,597 sq. ft.

The Company follows a scalable retail model comprising COCO, COFO and FOFO formats and uses local franchisee partnerships to expand its presence in regional markets. During Fiscal 2026, it acquired 51.04% shareholding in Olineo Nexus India Private Limited, adding 34 stores to its network. As of March 31, 2026, the Company was the largest mobile phone retail chain in West India and Maharashtra and the third largest in India among its peers, according to the cited industry report.
As of March 31, 2026, the Company had 689 permanent employees, comprising personnel across management, accounts and audit, operations, sales, sales support, supply chain and HR and administration.
strengths: Large and rapidly expanding retail store network.
Scalable COCO, COFO and FOFO business models.
Strong presence in Tier II and Tier III and beyond cities.
Strong customer reach through local franchisee partnerships.
Largest mobile phone retail chain in West India and Maharashtra.
Experienced Promoter and management team with strong domain expertise.
Wide product portfolio with focus on mobile phones, accessories and electronic items.
Established brand presence through SS Mobile, Mobile Exchange Wala and The Mobile Space.

faqs.question: How to apply in SS Retail IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in SS Retail IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in SS Retail IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in SS Retail IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' SS Retail IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When SS Retail IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The SS Retail IPO opens on Wed, Sep 16, 2026 and closes on Fri, Sep 18, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of SS Retail IPO?
faqs.answer: SS Retail IPO lot size is 35 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,840 .

faqs.question: How to apply for SS Retail IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in SS Retail IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is SS Retail IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for SS Retail IPO will be done on Monday, September 21, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 22, 2026 . Check the SS Retail IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is SS Retail IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The SS Retail IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 23, 2026 .
